title: Ministry of Power Pavilion at 45th India International Trade Fair
subtitle: Showcases Power Sector Initiatives in the last decade
body_text: The Ministry of Power Pavilion at the 45th India International Trade Fair (IITF) 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi showcases the initiatives and achievements of the power sector in the last decade. Using technology to simplify the power sector initiatives and to make it entertaining for the Fair audience, the pavilion makes use of interactive exhibits, an immersive zone, kinetic wall, anamorphic 3D display, rotating LED, virtual reality (VR) models, 3D project models and a Smart Home demonstrating energy-efficient appliances and smart energy solutions. The pavilion was inaugurated by Sh. Pankaj Agarwal, Secretary Ministry of Power yesterday and a brochure on the pavilion was also unveiled on the occasion. Others present included Dr. Saibaba Darbamulla, Additional Director (MoP), Ms. Reetu Jain, Economic Advisor, MoP, Sh. Vamsi Rama Mohan Burra, CMD, POWERGRID, members of the Board of Directors and senior officials of POWERGRID, NTPC, NHPC, PFC, REC, SJVN, THDC, EESL, BEE. The pavilion provides a common platform for different organisations in the Power Ministry to showcase their contributions towards strengthening India's power infrastructure and advancing the vision of a sustainable and energy-secure nation. The stall showcases CCU and Green Chemical Innovation at Pudimadaka, Green Hydrogen from waste (plasma oxy-gasification), Pudimadaka Green Hydrogen Hub Model, CO2 Battery (closed Brayton cycle), Vanadium Redox Flow Battery (VRFB), Battery Energy Storage System, Nuclear Awareness Campaign, PG AMRIT (AI in Transmission), 1100 kV AC Transmission, Regional Development Center, Pumped Storage Projects, NHPC Early Warning System “Surakashit Ujjawal Bhavishya” including for GLOF, Smart Meter app showcasing consumer functions such as Time of Day, Efficiency and Bill Prediction, Breach of Bill, Breach of Load, Breach of Limit etc. through AMISP, Smart Meter v/s Traditional Meter myth buster, India Energy Stack and PM Surya Ghar Yojanaya and P2P lending, Consumer Energy Passport and Smart Energy Efficiency Home. ­­­­ The pavilion which is part of the 45th India International Trade Fair (IITF) 2026 can be visited till November 27, 2026. It will also feature cultural programmes, including Nukkad Natak and flute and tabla performances, offering visitors an engaging experience while creating awareness about India's power sector initiatives and technological advancements. Some of the popular attractions at the pavilion include AI photo booth, selfie point, etc. A special attraction for younger audiences visiting the stall is the interaction with Chota Bheem characters. *** NR/MD
